newsitem.title: USA: Belden cites higher margins for Q4 gain.
newsitem.headline: Belden cites higher margins for Q4 gain.

text.p: Belden Inc said on Thursday that improved margins helped net income rise by 10 percent in the fourth quarter, although revenues fell four percent.
The company said net income in the period rose to $15.9 million, from $14.3 milion one year ago. Revenues totaled $171.4 million, versus $177.8 million last year.
Belden said demand for electrical products and cable television products was weak, although demand for computer networking, broadcast and industrial cables increased.
Belden makes wire and cable for electronic and electrical makets. Its shares were up one Thursday at 37-3/4.
